digest.component_or_area: ticket state model and write surfaces
propositions: Add two new ticket state fields `bridge_project` (tri-state string) and `repos` (list of strings) to schema and reducer projection
Expose `--bridge-project` and `--repos` create-time arguments on all three write surfaces (CLI, library, MCP) and wire them through `create_core` into CREATE event data
Implement promote-only edit guard for `bridge_project` that allows creation on unbound tickets but blocks modification on tickets that already hold a binding, while `repos` remains freely editable
Ensure tri-state `bridge_project` correctly distinguishes absent (legacy), explicit empty string (never sync), and set value (sync to project) after event replay
Generate types from updated schemas and maintain cross-surface parity such that CLI, library, and MCP create paths produce identical ticket state
